decision: No lossless official US closed one-minute bar plus quote source is proven at the frozen current base. L1 and L3-L7 remain blocked.

required_field_status.permissions: MISSING; chmod 0700/0600 returned success but this /mnt/D mount reports 0755 for the directory and every payload

blocking_facts: official.Client.RawMinuteCandles preserves raw decimal and timestamp strings but rejects market US before any HTTP request.
official.Client.Candles is the generic official path but converts timestamp with time.Parse and decimals with strconv.ParseFloat before exposing domain.Chart.
official.Client.Prices and official.Client.Orderbook similarly expose float-adapted domain values; no raw US quote DTO was found in internal/official.
No authenticated external request was sent: the lossless source precondition already fails locally, and credentials/configuration were intentionally not inspected.
Consequently there is no sanitized raw US body, terminal pagination transcript, observed USD result, observed US regular-session join, or observed rate-header budget to seal.
The receipt directory and payloads requested chmod 0700/0600, but this /mnt/D filesystem reports 0755 after a successful chmod; the required POSIX modes are therefore not independently verified.
prohibited_actions_not_taken: engine, Docker, container, toggle, journal, build, install, stage, commit, push, or deployment mutation
